A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was the '''father''' to a [[Unidentified naval son|son]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[4 BBY]], they traveled to [[Chandrila]] with their son to attended the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of the [[Chandrilan]]s [[Stekan Sculdun]] and [[Leida Mothma]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, it's a proud tradition in our family. We've all treasured our naval service.|Father talking with Luthen Rael about their family's naval service|<ref name="One Year Later" />}}
The older [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was proud of their family's tradition of [[Navy|naval]] service. In [[4 BBY]], they attended the three-[[Local day|day]] [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] [[Stekan Sculdun]] and [[Leida Mothma]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on [[Chandrila]] with their [[Unidentified naval son|son]] who was a [[Imperial Navy]] [[cadet]]. During the first day of the wedding they chatted about their military service with [[Luthen Rael]] inside one of the estate's buildings.<ref name="One Year Later" />

On the second day of the wedding, the man and their son attended the wedding dinner on the estate during which [[Perrin Fertha]], the father of the Leida, gave a speech from in the center of the room, welcoming the guests in [[Chandrilan (language)/Legends|Chandrilan]] and toasting his health before offering advice to Stekan and Leida.<ref name="Sagrona">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> One the final day, the father and son were part of the crowd that watched Davo unveil his wedding gift to the newly-weds, a [[Chandi Merle]] statue. Soon after, they watched Leida and Stekan perform a dance after which the guests mingled. A [[speaker droid]] then entered the room and began playing [[Niamos!|music]] for the guests to dance to.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The man had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
During the first day of the wedding, they wore an orange [[robe]] with a gold sash round the waist and a gold [[cape]].<ref name="One Year Later" /> On the second day<ref name="Sagrona" /> and third days of the wedding they wore a silver robe.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
The father was portrayed by [[Robin Sebastian]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first three episodes "[[One Year Later]]", "[[Sagrona Teema]]", and "[[Harvest]]", which were all released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
